description: Show the most likely Java or Spring root cause for a multi-line error event.
steps: Add a parser test with a Java stack trace that contains multiple `Caused by` sections.
Extract the deepest meaningful cause line from the event without changing the existing raw log text.
Render a compact root-cause line in the preview detail when the stack is expanded.
Run the parser and preview tests and confirm the existing Spring Boot port failure test still passes.

description: Show the most likely Python traceback root cause for a multi-line error event.
steps: Add a parser test with a Python traceback ending in a specific exception line.
Extract the final exception line as the root cause for Python traceback events.
Render the extracted Python root cause in the same preview detail area used by Java events.
Run the parser and preview tests and confirm Java root-cause extraction still passes.

description: Let users expand an error row to inspect nearby log events before and after it.
steps: Add state for a context-window toggle keyed by preview row line number.
Render a `Context` button on ERROR and FATAL preview rows.
Show up to three previous and three next parsed events in a detail row when the button is active.
Verify in the browser that toggling context does not clear search, level, or time filters.

description: Generate a copyable Markdown report for one selected error event.
steps: Add a pure formatter that builds Markdown from one row, its root cause, diagnostic match, and nearby context.
Add tests that assert the report includes level, line number, summary, root cause, diagnostic title, and raw snippet.
Add a `Report` button on ERROR and FATAL preview rows that opens a report detail panel.
Run module tests and verify the panel shows report text for the Spring Boot port failure sample.

description: Allow users to copy the generated Markdown issue report from the preview.
steps: Add a copy button inside the report detail panel.
Use the Clipboard API when available and show a short success or failure status message.
Add a fallback that selects the report text when clipboard writing is unavailable.
Verify in the browser that copying a Spring Boot report keeps the preview row expanded.

description: Detect trace, request, correlation, and span identifiers from parsed log rows.
steps: Add parser tests for `traceId`, `requestId`, `correlationId`, and `spanId` formats.
Store detected identifiers on each parsed row without changing existing summary counts.
Render compact identifier chips in preview rows that contain detected identifiers.
Run parser and app entry smoke tests to confirm rows without identifiers still render normally.

description: Let users filter the preview to all events from the same detected trace or request ID.
steps: Add preview state for an active identifier filter.
Make identifier chips clickable and filter rows to matching identifier values.
Show the active identifier filter as a removable chip above the preview.
Verify in the browser that identifier filtering composes with keyword and level filters.

description: Explain why a diagnostic knowledge-base rule matched an error event.
steps: Extend diagnostic matching to return the rule ID and matched pattern label or regex source.
Add a test that confirms `PortAlreadyInUse` exposes the matching evidence.
Render a `Matched because` line in the diagnostic detail panel.
Verify existing diagnostic suggestions still show their reason and solution lists.

description: Allow users to import a local custom diagnostics JSON file for the current session.
steps: Add an import control near the diagnostics or upload options area.
Validate the selected JSON with the existing diagnostics loader and show a clear error for invalid files.
Merge valid custom rules after built-in rules so custom matches can extend coverage.
Verify in the browser that a custom rule can produce a diagnostic suggestion for a sample error.

description: Provide a downloadable custom diagnostics JSON template.
steps: Add an export-template button near the custom diagnostics import control.
Generate a small JSON template containing one example rule with match, reason, details, and solutions fields.
Download the template as `diagnostics-custom-template.json`.
Verify the downloaded template can be re-imported without validation errors.

description: Assign user-visible severity labels to high-impact error events.
steps: Add a severity helper that maps startup failure, out-of-memory, database unavailable, fatal, and generic error events to labels.
Add tests for critical, high, medium, and low severity examples.
Render the severity label in ERROR and FATAL preview rows.
Verify existing level badges and diagnostic buttons still fit inside the preview row.

description: Summarize severity counts above the preview so users can judge impact quickly.
steps: Compute severity counts from parsed rows during analysis.
Render a compact severity summary near the level distribution or metrics area.
Make the summary hide itself when no ERROR or FATAL rows exist.
Verify in the browser that loading the sample log updates severity counts without changing total line metrics.

description: Show a compact timeline of notable startup and error events.
steps: Select notable events from parsed rows, including WARN, ERROR, FATAL, startup failure, shutdown, and retry messages.
Render a timeline section with time, level, and short message for each notable event.
Limit the timeline to a readable number of entries and show a count when events are omitted.
Verify in the browser that the Spring Boot startup failure appears in the timeline.

description: Let users click a timeline item to jump the preview toward the related event.
steps: Make timeline items clickable with a stable line-number target.
When clicked, apply a temporary line focus state and expand the matching preview row if it is visible.
Show a clear message when the focused line is hidden by current filters.
Verify in the browser that clearing filters reveals the focused timeline event.

description: Document the new log intelligence workflow for future users and agents.
steps: Add a README section that describes root cause, context, reports, trace filters, severity, and timeline features.
Mention that all diagnostics and reports remain local in the browser.
Add the relevant new files to the file overview if implementation added any new modules.
Check that the README links and headings render clearly from repository root.

description: Verify the completed log intelligence workflow through the browser UI.
steps: Start the static site with the project init or local HTTP server command.
Load a fixture containing Spring Boot, Python traceback, and traceId-linked events.
Verify root cause, context, diagnostic explanation, report, trace filter, severity, and timeline are visible.
Run the module test suite and record the exact commands used.
